name: total-pipe-v3
description: Four-tool Agent entry for topic-driven and research presentations, with resumable jobs and editable PowerPoint output.

interface.shortDescription: Create editable PowerPoint decks from a topic or paper.
interface.longDescription: Resumable Agent entry with doctor/start/advance/status. Topic jobs author content and render through PageScene. Paper jobs retain the Story, source review and Deck IR workflow.
defaultPrompt: Turn this research paper into a presentation deck.
Create a presentation from this topic or question.
Compile and inspect this deck with OfficeCLI.
